description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/bitcoin/tip (base $0.002; USDC on Base or Polygon); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET with no parameters. Latest Bitcoin block (height, hash, time, age) from mempool.space® (cached), charged only when the tip is read and the block header hashes to that tip. Fee estimates in sat/vB reported by mempool.space when available; if fees are missing the tip is still charged, marked partial:true with fees null. Source down or a header mismatch: not charged. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Mempool Holdings S.A. de C.V. Fee estimates do not guarantee inclusion. Information only. USDC on Base or Polygon. On USDC on Base, errors are not charged, apart from the exceptions noted on a route. On USDC on Solana, and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, a refused or failed request may still be charged. On Polygon (native USDC), a request is settled only when it succeeds (HTTP status below 400). Failed requests
